title: Gem
description: Gem library info and global settings

methods.description: turn OpenGL error debugging on/off for all Gem objects

body: The [Gem] object gives access to library-wide settings. Use the 'debugGL' message to track down which object triggers OpenGL errors (costly, disabled by default). When placed in a render chain, [Gem] draws the Gem splash graphic (it is an alias of [GemSplash]).
